sections.label: 範例完整 prompt
blocks:
生成一張高質感個股收盤報告 電視新聞圖表：

【標題】
11月美國物價變動

【構圖】
TV news infographic composition in a 16:9 horizontal layout, featuring a clean grid of evenly spaced item panels arranged in a row. Each panel contains a top label bar displaying the item name, a colorful vector illustration placed inside a soft circular badge, and a bottom section showing the price change. Use a bold red upward ▲ symbol for increases and a bold green downward ▼ symbol for decreases, placed directly before the percentage. Panels use structured spacing, clear alignment, safe margins, subtle dividers, and a broadcast-style modular layout emphasizing clarity and comparability across categories.  do not show "-" or "+"

【風格】
Soft Art Deco

【解析度】1K
【畫面比例】16:9
【用途】電視新聞SOT使用的圖表

【要求】
最底部五分之一留白(延伸背景)
標題下方靠右小字 "資料來源: US. BLS"

【結果】
能源 +2.8%
肉類 +5.25%
雞蛋 +12.72%
麵包 +2.97%

GPT-5.2 Instant模型
用量額度比免費版多10倍
<強調>有廣告</強調>

更多模型、更多限額
生成圖片更快

[內文 右]
用量幾乎無限額

- Aspect ratio: 16:9 
- Resolution: 1K
- Broadcast-safe composition
- All elements must remain within clear safe margins
- Layout must remain locked regardless of data values

==================================================
STYLE (VISUAL LANGUAGE ONLY)
==================================================
Soft Art Deco,
Dark Blue, Gold, Silver
底圖顏色: Dark Blue
強調色: Gold
內文通常色: Silver

==================================================
BOTTOM SAFE AREA (CRITICAL — MUST PRESERVE)
==================================================

  - NO charts
  - NO divider lines

/* 
PROMPT — International News Graphic (Layout Locked)
*/

A clean international news graphic layout that matches the uploaded reference image in overall structure, hierarchy, and visual logic.
The reference image defines the general layout style, while the rules below take priority for exact positioning, proportions, and safe-area control.
Do not reinterpret, redesign, or add new layout elements.

CANVAS:
- Aspect ratio: 16:9
- Resolution: 1K (2560x1440)
- Broadcast-quality, suitable for TV news and digital editorial use

LEFT SECTION:
- A perfect circular portrait crop of a single person
- Circle placed on the LEFT side of the canvas
- Vertically aligned with the main text block (not the geometric center of the canvas)
- Clean circular edge, no border, no stroke, no shadow
- Subject facing forward or slightly forward-facing
- Serious, calm, neutral expression
- Realistic photographic style
- Soft lighting, natural skin tones
- Background inside the circle is low-contrast and slightly blurred

IMAGE SOURCE & SCALING (STRICT):
- The portrait image MUST be created strictly from the user-uploaded image
- No synthetic faces, no reimagined likeness, no substitution subjects
- The uploaded image may only be scaled down to fit the circular mask
- Image scaling must preserve the original aspect ratio with no distortion
- The circular portrait MUST be proportionally reduced to fit the defined left image column
- The portrait must never appear visually dominant or oversized

LEFT COLUMN WIDTH CONSTRAINT (HARD LIMIT):
- The entire left image column (including the circular portrait and its internal padding) MUST occupy EXACTLY 15% of the total canvas width
- Under no circumstances may the left image column exceed 15% of the canvas width
- The circular portrait diameter must be sized relative to this 15% column and scaled down accordingly
- The left section must appear clearly secondary and visually subordinate to the right text area

CENTER DIVIDER:
- One thin vertical divider line immediately to the RIGHT of the circular portrait
- Color: muted cool blue or blue-grey
- Line starts aligned with the top of the active content area
- Line ends at 80% of the total image height
- The divider line MUST NOT enter the bottom one-fifth area

RIGHT TEXT AREA (LEFT-ALIGNED ONLY):
- Clean editorial text layout with controlled, professional white space
- No centering, no justification
- The top edge of the right text area MUST begin at exactly 15% of the total canvas height measured from the top
- All headline, body text, and source handle elements must flow downward from this fixed starting position
- This top offset is mandatory to prevent excessive empty space above the content and to maintain broadcast-safe vertical balance

HEADLINE ROW:
- A flat, monochrome social media icon corresponding to [來源社群]
  (example: X, TruthSocial — icon must change with the platform)
- Icon placed directly before the headline text
- Headline text content: [人名]
- Typeface: serif or transitional serif
- Weight: medium to semibold
- Color: dark grey to near-black

BODY TEXT:
- Positioned below the headline
- Text block width limited to approximately 70% of the right-side area
- Lighter font weight than headline
- Softer grey color
- Editorial news-style line breaks
- Text content: [內文]

SOURCE HANDLE:
- Positioned below the body text
- Smaller size, lighter color
- Text content: [來源帳號]

BOTTOM SAFE AREA (CRITICAL):
- The bottom 20% (one-fifth) of the entire image must contain:
  - NO text
  - NO icons
  - NO divider lines
  - NO decorative elements
- Because this bottom safe area must remain completely empty, all active content must be confined to the upper 80% of the canvas
- The overall composition must feel compact, top-weighted, and visually balanced
- The top area must NOT appear overly empty or visually loose
- Only extend the background smoothly downward
- No hard edges, no visual interruption

STYLE & TONE:
Streamline modern  設計感

STRICT PROHIBITIONS:
- Do NOT add any extra UI or visual elements
- Do NOT violate the defined left column width, top offset, or bottom safe area
- Do NOT allow any object to enter the bottom one-fifth area
- Do NOT output placeholder brackets or symbols in the final image

FINAL OUTPUT RULE:
- The final generated image must NOT contain any "[" "]" or "<" ">" characters; these symbols are instructional placeholders only and must never appear in the rendered image.

templates.name: 地圖 國家位置+指定地點

sections.label: 規則 prompt
blocks:
You will generate a TVBS-style Google Maps vector map in 16:9. 
All geographic markers MUST be placed strictly according to actual coordinates. 
No beautification adjustment or repositioning is allowed.

===== USER INPUT =====
國家名稱（中文）：{Country_Chinese}
指定地點名稱（中文）：{Location_Name_Chinese}
指定地點座標（lat,long）：{Location_Coordinates}
地點標籤（可留白）：{Location_Tag}
===== END USER INPUT =====

PROCESSING RULES:
1. Translate {Country_Chinese} → English country name automatically.
2. Obtain capital coordinates + its Chinese name automatically.
3. DO NOT display any coordinate numbers in the final image.
4. DO NOT display English name of the specified location.
5. If {Location_Tag} is empty:
       Location_Label = {Location_Name_Chinese}
   Else:
       Location_Label = [白字框] {Location_Tag}  {Location_Name_Chinese}
6. Capital label ALWAYS:
       [白字框] 首都  {Capital_Chinese_Name}

============================================================
MAP CONSTRUCTION (STRICT RULES FOR POSITION & GEOGRAPHIC ACCURACY)
============================================================

1. Base Map Style:
   - Use TVBS-style Google Maps vector aesthetic.
   - Land: #DDE2EA / #C8CFD9 (muted gray-blue)
   - Water: #AFC4D6 / #B8D0E0 (soft blue-gray)
   - Add subtle hillshade terrain (not strong).
   - Clean, crisp, no clutter.

2. National Boundaries:
   - 主國國界：粗深色線 (#1A1A1A)
   - 鄰國國界：細鐵灰線 (#6C6C6C)
   - 國界可自然延伸超出畫面頂端。

3. Country Name:
   - Format:
        {Country_Chinese}  {Country_English}
   - 不用括號。
   - English name → TVBS standard blue (#1E4FC7).
   - Chinese name → dark gray (#333333).
   - 放在主國國土的上半部視覺中心。

4. Neighbor Countries:
   - 顯示繁體中文名稱。
   - 細鐵灰字體 (#6C6C6C)。
   - 無英文。

============================================================
STRICT COORDINATE-BASED MARKER RULES（最重要）
============================================================

5. Capital Marker Placement:
   - Place a black star EXACTLY at the true geographic coordinate.

templates.name: 地震速報地圖

sections.label: 範例完整 prompt
blocks:
You will generate a TV news “Earthquake Breaking Alert” infographic in 16:9.

===== INPUT =====
M 6.4 - 27 km E of Santiago, Philippines
2026-01-07 03:02:58 (UTC)
7.254°N 126.823°E
58.5 km depth
===== END INPUT =====

From the INPUT, automatically extract and convert:

1. Parse the USGS location string (e.g., “104 km N of Yakutat, Alaska”).

2. Translate ALL place names into Traditional Chinese.

3. Reconstruct the location as:
   “{TranslatedPlaceName}{DirectionChinese}{Distance}公里”

   Direction conversion:
   N → 以北
   S → 以南
   E → 以東
   W → 以西
   NE → 東北方
   NW → 西北方
   SE → 東南方
   SW → 西南方

4. Extract the COUNTRY only (translated into Traditional Chinese) for the main title.

5. Extract Magnitude (M).

6. Extract UTC date-time and convert to Taiwan time (UTC+8),
   formatted as:
   “MM-DD HH:MM:SS”

7. Extract depth (km).

8. Extract Epicenter coordinates (latitude & longitude),
   and **MUST convert decimal degrees into Degrees–Minutes–Seconds (DMS) format**:

   - Decimal degree input example:
     7.254°N 126.823°E

   - Convert to:
     (7°15'14.4"N 126°49'22.8"E)

   Conversion rules:
   - Degrees (°) are the integer part.
   - Minutes (') = integer part of (decimal × 60).
   - Seconds (") = remaining × 60.
   - Seconds must be rounded to **one decimal place**.
   - Preserve hemisphere indicators: N / S / E / W.
   - Final format MUST be exactly:
     (Lat°Min'Sec"N Lon°Min'Sec"E)

Infographic composition rules:

1. Main title (large font):
   “{Country_TraditionalChinese} M {Magnitude} 地震”

2. Unified secondary line (same line):
   - “震源深度 {Depth} km” (medium font, centered)
   - Taiwan time “台灣時間 MM-DD HH:MM:SS” (small font, right-aligned)

3. Main map:
   - Generate a clean Google-Maps-style vector map around this area.
   - Mark the Epicenter using the converted DMS coordinates.
   - Use vivid red concentric rings to indicate the epicenter.
   - The map must occupy the majority of the frame.
   - The bottom one-fifth (1/5) of the entire 16:9 frame is NOT a separate box.
   - It is the same map extended downward seamlessly.
   - No borders, no dividers, no distinct background section.
   - The image must appear as one continuous Google Maps-style map.

4. Right-side info box:
   - 震央位置：{TranslatedDistanceDirectionString}
   - 座標：（{DMS_Latitude} {DMS_Longitude}）

5. Bottom-right of the map:
   “資料來源：USGS” (small font)

Style:
Clean modern TV news infographic, minimal clutter, crisp vector map graphics,
smooth gradients, strong visual hierarchy, muted Google-Maps-style colors,
vivid red epicenter rings, broadcast-safe layout.

All visible text must be Traditional Chinese.

sections.label: 規則 prompt {需自行填上資料}
blocks:
You will generate a TV news “Earthquake Breaking Alert” infographic in 16:9, styled in the visual language of TVBS News.

===== INPUT (User will paste raw USGS text here) =====
{USGS_INPUT}
===== END INPUT =====

From the INPUT, automatically extract and convert:

1. Parse the USGS location string (e.g., “104 km N of Yakutat, Alaska”).
2. Translate ALL place names into Traditional Chinese.
3. Convert into:
   “{TranslatedPlaceName}{DirectionChinese}{Distance}公里”
   Direction conversion:
   N → 以北
   S → 以南
   E → 以東
   W → 以西
   NE → 東北方
   NW → 西北方
   SE → 東南方
   SW → 西南方

4. Extract COUNTRY only (translated to Traditional Chinese) for the main title.
5. Extract Magnitude (M).
6. Convert UTC → Taiwan time (UTC+8), formatted “MM-DD HH:MM:SS”.
7. Extract depth (km).
8. Extract coordinates.

Infographic composition rules:

1. Main title (large font):
   “{Country_TraditionalChinese} M {Magnitude} 地震”
   Styled with TVBS signature purple (#4A3C91) or deep blue-purple gradient.

2. Unified secondary line (same line):
   - “震源深度 {Depth} km” (medium font, centered)
   - Taiwan time “台灣時間 MM-DD HH:MM:SS” (small font, right-aligned)
   Text colors follow TVBS light-gray #EDEDED or dark-gray #333333 depending on contrast.

3. Main map:
   - Google-Maps-style clean vector map based on coordinates.
   - Epicenter marked with vivid TVBS red (#E53935) concentric rings.
   - Land areas may use desaturated gray-blue tones (#DDE2EA / #C8CFD9) for TVBS aesthetics.
   - **The bottom one-ninth (1/9) of the entire frame must be a seamless downward extension of the SAME map.**
   - No borders, no separate boxes, no color changes.

4. Right-side info box:
   Use TVBS visual UI style:
   - Rounded rectangle panel in white (#FFFFFF) or very light gray (#F7F7F7)
   - Thin separators in soft gray (#D0D0D0)
   - 震央位置：{TranslatedDistanceDirectionString}

5. Bottom-right (small font):
   “資料來源：USGS”
   In TVBS gray #9A9A9A.

Color Style (TVBS standard):
- Primary: TVBS Signature Purple #4A3C91
- Accent: TVBS Orange #F36F21 (for minor highlights)
- Epicenter: TVBS Emergency Red #E53935

You will generate a TV news “Earthquake Breaking Alert” infographic in 16:9.

M 5.2 - 221 km WSW of Tual, Indonesia
2025-12-07 04:55:53 (UTC)6.612°S 131.006°E35.0 km depth
===== END INPUT =====

From the INPUT, automatically extract and convert:

1. Parse the USGS location string (e.g., “104 km N of Yakutat, Alaska”).
2. Translate ALL place names into Traditional Chinese.
3. Convert into:
   “{TranslatedPlaceName}{DirectionChinese}{Distance}公里”
   Direction conversion:
   N → 以北
   S → 以南
   E → 以東
   W → 以西
   NE → 東北方
   NW → 西北方
   SE → 東南方
   SW → 西南方

4. Extract COUNTRY only (translated to Traditional Chinese) for the main title.
5. Extract Magnitude (M).
6. Convert UTC → Taiwan time (UTC+8), formatted “MM-DD HH:MM:SS”.
7. Extract depth (km).
8. Extract coordinates.

Infographic composition rules:

1. Main title (large font):
   “{Country_TraditionalChinese} M {Magnitude} 地震”
   Styled with TVBS signature purple (#4A3C91) or deep blue-purple gradient.

   - Epicenter marked with vivid TVBS red (#E53935) concentric rings.

sections.label: 範例完整 prompt
blocks:
/* 
PROMPT — Quote News Graphic (Broadcast Safe)
*/

Create a clean, authoritative quote-style news graphic based on the uploaded reference image.
The graphic must function as a flat quote report for international news, suitable for TV broadcast and digital platforms.

The layout and visual hierarchy should closely follow the reference style, while respecting the structural constraints defined below.
Do NOT reinterpret the format into posters, social cards, or promotional graphics.

CANVAS:
- Aspect ratio: 16:9
- Resolution: 1K (2560 × 1440)
- Broadcast-quality output
- Designed for headline + quote presentation

TOP MARGIN SAFE AREA (MANDATORY):
- The top 15% of the canvas is a mandatory empty margin
- This area must contain ONLY background color
- NO text, logos, images, graphic elements, or visual accents may appear in this area
- This top margin must be visually present and clearly perceptible as empty space
- Do NOT place content flush to the top edge of the canvas

ACTIVE CONTENT AREA:
- All primary content must be placed between 15% and 80% of the total canvas height
- Content must begin immediately below the 15% top margin
- The composition must feel top-weighted, compact, and visually balanced within this active zone

BOTTOM SAFE AREA (CRITICAL — MUST PRESERVE):
- The bottom 20% (one-fifth) of the entire image must contain:
  - NO text
  - NO logos
  - NO icons
  - NO divider lines
  - NO decorative elements
- This area is reserved strictly as a broadcast-safe zone
- The background color or background image from the active content area above MUST extend downward into this area
- The extension must be seamless and continuous, with no change in color, texture, or visual tone
- No hard edges, no visual breaks, no additional overlays or gradients

TOP SECTION — SOURCE & HEADLINE:
- Place the media source logo at the top-left area
- The logo must correspond exactly to the media outlet specified in [來源媒體]
- Use the official logo style of the specified media outlet
- Logo size should be modest and editorial, never dominant
- The logo must be visually smaller than the quote text in the quote section
- Logo must sit on a clean, light background
- Display the original quoted headline provided in [來源標題]
- This headline represents the original reporting title from the source media
- Typeface: classic news serif or transitional serif
- Color: near-black or dark grey
- Weight: bold to semibold
- The headline font size MUST be smaller than the main quote text in the QUOTE SECTION
- The headline must function as contextual information, not the primary visual focus
- Line breaks should feel editorial and restrained

DIVIDING TRANSITION (DESIGN FEATURE):
- A horizontal torn-paper or rough-edge transition separates the top headline section from the quote section
- The torn edge should feel organic, subtle, and realistic
- No exaggerated textures, shadows, or graphic effects
- This transition acts as a visual boundary, not a decorative element

QUOTE SECTION — MAIN CONTENT:
- Below the torn-paper edge, place a solid or subtly textured color block
- The visual style and color palette must follow [風格]
- If [風格] is not specified by the user, default to the visual style of the uploaded reference image

- Display the main quote text provided in [內文]
- The content must be written in Traditional Chinese (繁體中文)
- Typeface: bold, modern sans-serif suitable for TV subtitles
- High contrast against the background
- Large font size optimized for on-air readability
- Text should be visually centered within the quote block
- Line breaks should prioritize clarity and broadcast legibility

LAYOUT BEHAVIOR:
- Maintain strong visual hierarchy in the following order:
  1. Media source logo from [來源媒體]
  2. Original headline from [來源標題]
  3. Quote content from [內文]
- The quote block must never intrude into the bottom safe area
- The overall design should feel restrained, authoritative, and journalistic

STYLE & TONE:
- International news aesthetic
- Minimalist, sober, high credibility
- No gradients, no glow, no neon colors
- No playful or social-media-style elements

STRICT PROHIBITIONS:
- Do NOT place any element inside the bottom one-fifth area
- Do NOT add extra UI frames, badges, or decorative icons
- Do NOT exaggerate the torn-paper effect
- Do NOT output any placeholder brackets or instructional symbols in the final image

FINAL OUTPUT RULE:
- The final generated image must NOT contain any "[" "]" or "<" ">" characters
- All bracketed variable fields are instructions only and must be replaced with their actual content before rendering

VARIABLE FIELDS:
- [來源媒體] The New York Times
- [來源標題] Iran’s Fractured Leadership Is Struggling to Coordinate, Officials Say
- [內文1] 伊朗倖存官員<變色強調>擔心暗殺</變色強調>，不願打電話、面對面，難整合一致立場。
- [內文2] 
<變色強調>指揮體系受損</變色強調>，難協同密集反擊攻勢。

 [風格] soft Art Deco. Dark Blue, Gold, Silver

Background should use white (#FFFFFF), soft gray-white tones (#F7F7F7–#EDEDED), or very light pastel yellow (#FFF8E5) for a warm but clean newsroom-friendly canvas. The background must remain low-contrast and low-saturation to ensure maximum text clarity and strong separation from the foreground graphics. Subtle vignette gradients or soft ambient lighting may be applied, but the backdrop should remain visually quiet and uncluttered.

Clean semi-flat vector illustration with an editorial infographic aesthetic, simple and clear iconography, minimal ornamentation, sharp outline edges and a crisp digital aesthetic.

Background should use white (#FFFFFF), soft gray-white tones (#F7F7F7–#EDEDED), or very light pastel yellow (#FFF8E5) for a warm but clean newsroom-friendly canvas. Subtle vignette gradients or soft ambient lighting may be applied, but the backdrop should remain visually quiet and uncluttered.

Supporting tones include navy tints derived from #4A3C91 for depth, and soft lavender-blue tints for secondary zones. Accent yellow (#FFCC00) should be used sparingly to preserve hierarchy and avoid visual overload against the light background.

Soft gradients with controlled lighting across the blue/purple spectrum, smooth transitions between dark-to-mid tones for depth, subtle ambient glows around focal elements, and refined shadow layers suitable for TV broadcast output. Bold sans-serif headline font, large clean subheading text, high-readability information typography, clear numeric emphasis and consistent typographic hierarchy. Crisp digital rendering with smooth gradients, soft shadows, high dynamic contrast, no noise and no clutter, fully optimized for TV newsroom infographic production.

Create a professional international TV news infographic designed for broadcast and digital editorial use.
The output must strictly follow the style, structure, and data logic defined below.
Do not redesign, reinterpret, or alter the layout logic.

==================================================
CANVAS
==================================================

- Aspect ratio: 16:9 
- Resolution: 1K
- Broadcast-safe composition
- All elements must remain within clear safe margins
- Layout must remain locked regardless of data values

==================================================
STYLE (VISUAL LANGUAGE ONLY)
==================================================

Blue / Gold / Silver
Contemporary Art Decor Editorial Graphic Style

==================================================
STRUCTURE (LAYOUT RULES)
==================================================

LEFT SIDE:
- A single person portrait placed on the LEFT side of the frame
- Occupies approximately 40% of the canvas width
- Cropped from mid-chest to head
- Facing slightly toward the center
- Subject is NOT centered

RIGHT SIDE:
- Reserved exclusively for structured information blocks
- Arranged vertically

TOP RIGHT:
- One large headline text area spanning horizontally
- Displays the main title

IMMEDIATELY BELOW HEADLINE (RIGHT-ALIGNED):
- A very small text line displaying the data source
- Right-aligned to the headline text block
- Minimal font size, clearly secondary
- Must not compete visually with the headline or bars
- Displays: [資料來源]

MIDDLE RIGHT:
- Two horizontal bar chart rows stacked vertically

Each bar row structure (left to right):
- Left-aligned text label area
- Central horizontal bar area
- Right-aligned numeric/value area
- Optional small indicator space immediately to the right of the value

- The two bars must be evenly spaced
- Bars and numeric values must align to consistent vertical axes
- No overlap between elements

BOTTOM RIGHT:
- A small fine-text area reserved for optional notes
- Must not interfere with primary visual hierarchy

READING FLOW:
Left portrait → top-right headline → data source → bar #1 → bar #2 → right-side values

==================================================
VARIABLE FIELDS (USER INPUT)
==================================================

[標題]  川普施政滿意度
[資料來源] 來源:Reuters/Ipsos
[bar#1 小標題]  2026年1月
[bar#1 數字]  42%
[bar#2 小標題] 2025年12月
[bar#2 數字] 39%

"< >" "[ ]" 是給你的指令 不要生成在結果上

==================================================
DATA LOGIC & CALCULATION RULES
==================================================

- bar#2 is the baseline reference
- bar#1 is the comparison value

Calculate change using the formula:

([bar#1 數字] − [bar#2 數字]) ÷ [bar#2 數字] × 100

==================================================
COLOR & EMPHASIS RULES
==================================================

- bar#1:
  - Bar color: metallic gold
  - Numeric value color: metallic gold
  - Arrow indicator (if present): metallic gold

- bar#2:
  - Bar color: metallic silver
  - Numeric value color: metallic silver
  - No arrow or comparison symbol allowed

==================================================
CHANGE INDICATOR RULES
==================================================

- ONLY apply change indicators to bar#1

If [bar#1 數字] > [bar#2 數字]:
- Display an upward arrow (↑) immediately next to bar#1 numeric value

If [bar#1 數字] < [bar#2 數字]:
- Display a downward arrow (↓) immediately next to bar#1 numeric value

If values are equal:
- Display no arrow

==================================================
DISPLAY CONSTRAINTS
==================================================

- bar#2 must NEVER display arrows or comparison symbols
- Numeric values must be displayed exactly as provided
- Do NOT display percentage numbers
- Directional change is communicated ONLY via arrows
- Bar lengths must visually reflect the ratio between numeric values
- Layout, spacing, and alignment must NOT shift due to data magnitude

==================================================
OUTPUT REQUIREMENT
==================================================
Generate a clean, accurate broadcast-ready data graphic where:
- Style remains authoritative and neutral
- Structure is fixed and reusable
- Color hierarchy clearly distinguishes comparison vs baseline
- Data dynamically controls bar length and arrow direction
- Data source text remains subtle and secondary
- All content updates strictly based on the [ ] fields
- No additional symbols, decorations, or reinterpretations are introduced

==================================================
BOTTOM SAFE AREA (CRITICAL — MUST PRESERVE)
==================================================
- The bottom 20% (one-fifth) of the entire image must contain:
  - NO text
  - NO logos
  - NO icons
  - NO charts
  - NO divider lines
  - NO decorative elements
- This area is reserved strictly as a broadcast-safe zone
- The background color or background image from the active content area above MUST extend downward into this area
- The extension must be seamless and continuous
- No change in color, texture, brightness, or visual tone
- No hard edges, no visual breaks, no overlays, no gradients

==================================================
FINAL OUTPUT RULE
==================================================
- The final generated image must NOT contain any "[" "]" or "<" ">" characters
- All bracketed variable fields are instructions only and must be replaced with their actual content before rendering

STYLE:

Create a high-end editorial infographic design with a deep navy blue, metallic gold, and brushed silver color palette, with STRONG emphasis on elongated horizontal bar elements as the primary visual language.

Overall Style & Mood
- Luxurious, authoritative, institutional
- Art Deco revival blended with modern broadcast infographic aesthetics
- Serious, calm, executive-level tone
- Designed for international TV news and political or financial analysis
- No playful elements, no illustration style, no casual layout

Core Design Focus — Horizontal Bars (CRITICAL)
- Long, horizontally stretched bars are the MAIN design feature
- Bars function as visual indicators, timelines, or comparison gauges
- Each bar is:
  - Rounded rectangle with softened ends
  - Metallic surface (gold for primary, silver for secondary)
  - Brushed metal texture with subtle directional grain
  - Light reflection sweeping horizontally across the bar
- Bars extend significantly across the canvas width to convey weight and authority
- Bar thickness is substantial, never thin or minimal
- Decorative Art Deco linework or radial motifs may be engraved INSIDE the bars
- Bars must feel solid, heavy, and premium, like precision-crafted metal components

Color System
- Background: deep navy blue gradient, subtle vignette toward edges
- Primary bar color: metallic gold with warm highlights
- Secondary bar color: brushed silver / platinum with cooler highlights
- Minimal accent lines in muted gold
- Controlled contrast, no oversaturation

Layout & Composition
- Strong horizontal reading flow
- Clear vertical stacking of bars for comparison
- Symmetrical and balanced composition
- Left side reserved for a framed portrait or main visual block
- Right side dominated by horizontal bars and numeric indicators
- Bars aligned on a strict grid system
- Generous negative space above and below bars to enhance clarity

Graphic Elements
- Art Deco–inspired geometric frames and borders
- Thin gold line frames enclosing major sections
- Fan-shaped or sunburst motifs used sparingly as background accents
- No drop shadows; depth is created ONLY through highlights and gradients
- Bars visually appear embedded into the layout, not floating

Typography Style
- Headline typography inspired by classic Art Deco serif forms
- Secondary text in clean, modern sans-serif
- Slightly expanded letter spacing
- Numbers are large, bold, and visually anchored to the bars
- Text appears embossed, engraved, or inlaid into metallic surfaces

Lighting & Texture
- Soft directional lighting, emphasizing horizontal reflections on bars
- Gentle metallic sheen, no harsh glare
- Smooth gradients, no noise, no grain
- Clean, broadcast-safe finish

Technical Constraints
- Aspect ratio: 16:9
- Resolution: 1K or higher
- Flat editorial infographic (NOT poster, NOT social media card)
- No cartoon, no anime, no painterly illustration
- Clean edges, crisp lines, TV-safe clarity

STRICTLY STYLE & DESIGN ONLY
- Do NOT add narrative or explanatory text
- Do NOT invent data, labels, or percentages
- Do NOT include real people unless specified elsewhere
- Focus entirely on visual system, bar design language, materials, and layout discipline

- Serious, calm, executive-level tone

- No playful elements, no illustration style, no casual layout

Core Design Focus — Horizontal Bars (CRITICAL)
- Long, horizontally stretched bars are the MAIN design feature
- Bars function as visual indicators, timelines, or comparison gauges
- Each bar is:
  - Rounded rectangle with softened ends
  - Metallic surface (gold for primary, silver for secondary)
  - Brushed metal texture with subtle directional grain
  - Light reflection sweeping horizontally across the bar
- Bars extend significantly across the canvas width to convey weight and authority
- Bar thickness is substantial, never thin or minimal
- Decorative Art Deco linework or radial motifs may be engraved INSIDE the bars
- Bars must feel solid, heavy, and premium, like precision-crafted metal components

Color System
- Background: deep navy blue gradient, subtle vignette toward edges
- Primary bar color: metallic gold with warm highlights
- Secondary bar color: brushed silver / platinum with cooler highlights
- Minimal accent lines in muted gold
- Controlled contrast, no oversaturation

Layout & Composition
- Strong horizontal reading flow
- Clear vertical stacking of bars for comparison
- Symmetrical and balanced composition
- Left side reserved for a framed portrait or main visual block
- Right side dominated by horizontal bars and numeric indicators
- Bars aligned on a strict grid system
- Generous negative space above and below bars to enhance clarity

- Art Deco–inspired geometric frames and borders
- Thin gold line frames enclosing major sections
- Fan-shaped or sunburst motifs used sparingly as background accents
- No drop shadows; depth is created ONLY through highlights and gradients
- Bars visually appear embedded into the layout, not floating

Typography Style
- Headline typography inspired by classic Art Deco serif forms
- Secondary text in clean, modern sans-serif
- Slightly expanded letter spacing
- Numbers are large, bold, and visually anchored to the bars
- Text appears embossed, engraved, or inlaid into metallic surfaces

Lighting & Texture
- Soft directional lighting, emphasizing horizontal reflections on bars
- Gentle metallic sheen, no harsh glare
- Smooth gradients, no noise, no grain
- Clean, broadcast-safe finish

- Aspect ratio: 16:9
- Resolution: 1K or higher
- Flat editorial infographic (NOT poster, NOT social media card)
- No cartoon, no anime, no painterly illustration
- Clean edges, crisp lines, TV-safe clarity

- Do NOT add narrative or explanatory text
- Do NOT invent data, labels, or percentages
- Do NOT include real people unless specified elsewhere
- Focus entirely on visual system, bar design language, materials, and layout discipline

- The extension must be seamless and continuous

- No hard edges, no visual breaks, no overlays, no gradients

sections.label: 構成要素
blocks:
### 1️⃣ **現代裝飾插畫背景（Modern Decorative Background Illustration）**
- 明顯不是「畫面主體」，而是**為文字與資訊服務的底圖**
- 中央大面積留白，非常典型的：
- 專題封面
- 活動主視覺
- 報告／論壇 KV
- 新聞專題標題頁
---
### 2️⃣ **半扁平向量插畫（Semi-flat Vector Style）**
- 植物以色塊為主
- 幾乎沒有寫實光影
- 僅用柔和漸層＋紙感顆粒增加層次
👉 這是現在「高級感 editorial 插畫」的主流做法
---
### 3️⃣ **熱帶植物幾何裝飾風（Tropical Botanical + Geometric Frame）**
- 熱帶葉片（龜背芋、棕櫚、闊葉）
- 分布在四角，形成**視覺框架**
- 不搶戲、只定調氣氛
👉 比上一張更「克制」、更適合嚴肅內容（永續、國際、論壇）
---
### 4️⃣ **Soft Art Deco / Contemporary Deco**
- 背景的：
- 淡色方格
- 菱形幾何角飾
- 是**Art Deco 的現代極簡版本**
- 沒有金屬感
- 沒有厚重線條
- 偏米色、沙色、暖白
👉 很「國際會議、COP、UN 系統」視覺語言
---
### 5️⃣ **Editorial Grid-based Layout 美感**
- 方格不是裝飾而已，而是「隱性版面系統」
- 方便後續：
- 排標題
- 放資訊框
- 做動畫或轉場
👉 這一點非常「新聞專題友善」

Create a professional international TV news infographic designed for broadcast and digital editorial use.
The output must strictly follow the style, structure, and data logic defined below.
Do not redesign, reinterpret, or alter the layout logic.

==================================================
CANVAS
==================================================

- Aspect ratio: 16:9 
- Resolution: 1K
- Broadcast-safe composition
- All elements must remain within clear safe margins
- Layout must remain locked regardless of data values

==================================================
STYLE (VISUAL LANGUAGE ONLY)
==================================================
Soft Art Deco, subtle geometric patterns, diffused lighting, Dark Blue, Gold, and Silver color scheme, balanced broadcast composition.

==================================================
STRUCTURE (LAYOUT RULES)
==================================================
Geopolitical Strategic Grid: Central 3D map illustration of the Strait of Hormuz showing the blockade lines. To the left, a vertical list of 'Economic Fury' action targets. To the right, a global trade flow diagram pointing toward China with a 'Secondary Sanctions' warning icon. High-tech digital overlay effects with red alert indicators for sanctioned vessels.

==================================================
VARIABLE FIELDS (USER INPUT)
==================================================
"< >" "[ ]" 是給你的指令 不要生成在結果上
[標題] 美重拳制裁伊朗石油工業
[制裁對象] <鎖定黑油網> 對20多名個人公司及船隻實施懲罰
[經濟怒火] <打擊政權菁英> 凍結利用石油出口牟利之黑金
[反制封鎖] <奪回海域航權> 強硬回擊荷莫茲海峽軍事封鎖
[嚴厲警告] <次級制裁威懾> 警告中國買家若持續買油將面臨制裁

==================================================
Text Rules
==================================================
Main Title:
- Positioned at the very top of the frame
- Rendered in bold 3D extruded typography with strong depth and lighting
Body Text:
- Clean and highly legible
- Do NOT use any commas or periods
- Use spaces only to separate phrases
Subtitles ([內文小標]):
- If the text length is fewer than 6 full-width characters (中文字), use a "Tag" (Label) visual representation (e.g., pill-shaped background, high-contrast block).
Text Styling Rules:
- Any text written as [text] or <text>:
→ Remove brackets or symbols
→ Apply highlight color such as yellow gold or cyan
→ Optional glow effect for emphasis
- Any <蓋章> marker:
→ Apply strong full-box highlight style to the following text
→ Use solid background color (e.g. red background with white text)
→ High contrast emphasis block

==================================================
BOTTOM SAFE AREA (CRITICAL — MUST PRESERVE)
==================================================
- The bottom 20% (one-fifth) of the entire image must contain:
  - NO text
  - NO logos
  - NO icons
  - NO charts
  - NO divider lines
  - NO decorative elements
- This area is reserved strictly as a broadcast-safe zone
- The background color or background image from the active content area above MUST extend downward into this area
- The extension must be seamless and continuous
- No change in color, texture, brightness, or visual tone
- No hard edges, no visual breaks, no overlays, no gradients

==================================================
FINAL OUTPUT RULE
==================================================
- The final generated image must NOT contain any "[" "]" or "<" ">" characters
- All bracketed variable fields are instructions only and must be replaced with their actual content before rendering

3B 籌碼 (美國要求 - 經濟利益)指美國希望中國採購的三大類商品，旨在為美國帶來實質的貿易紅利，鞏固川普國內選票：波音 (Boeing)： 爭取飛機訂單。大豆 (Beans)： 擴大農產品出口。牛肉 (Beef)： 增加食品貿易。 3T 議題 (中國需求 - 戰略制約)指中方希望美國放寬限制的三大領域，是影響美中競爭的關鍵科技與政策：關稅 (Tariffs)： 中方尋求延續貿易休戰，減少美方高關稅的打擊。科技 (Technology)： 高科技出口限制，中方要求放寬對先進半導體、AI 的限制。台灣 (Taiwan)： 中方重申在台灣問題上的立場，敦促美方減少對台支持。 「川習會」背景與局勢籌碼對接： 美方可能在 3B 議題（波音、大豆、牛肉）獲得訂單，但 3T 議題因涉及關鍵技術，雙方在能源、稀土、AI 等領域僵持。台灣籌碼化風險： 有分析指出，習近平可能把「關鍵礦產」作為籌碼來施壓美國，可能延宕對台軍售，迫使美國在「川習會」上進行交易。交易本質： 這被認為是「彼此依賴又互不信任」的結構性競爭關係。外界審慎預期此次會晤能否有重大突破。

sections.label: 範例完整 prompt
blocks:
把這段訊息整理精簡成字少好易讀的新聞圖表，多icon ，拆解成多個步驟，每個步驟要有主視覺大插圖，每個步驟只要中標題與小摘要，不要內文解釋

K-Nevada Gateway：韓國新創的美國登陸區
計畫目標：將內華達州的雷諾 (Reno) 和拉斯維加斯，打造成韓國 EnterTech 新創進入美國市場的戰略據點與技術測試場。
合作夥伴：內華達大學 (University of Nevada)、內華達州經濟發展局 (EDAWN)、沙漠研究所 (DRI) 等當地核心機構。
為新創提供的支持
資本對接：定期投資人介紹與商業媒合。
市場曝光：提供在 CES 2026 FutureTech 會議上向全球投資者展示的機會。
產業連結：對接特斯拉超級工廠 (Tesla Gigafactory) 等當地產業資源，並提供城市空中交通 (UAM) 等前沿技術的測試環境。

sections.label: 純風格 prompt
blocks:
A refined modern oriental illustration style, 
inspired by contemporary Chinese aesthetics and classic painting traditions, 
featuring clean, elegant composition and harmonious visual balance.
Soft jade green, muted teal, ivory white, warm red, and subtle gold accents dominate the palette, 
with calm, low-contrast tones and gentle color transitions. 
Colors feel mineral-based and natural, never oversaturated, never harsh.
Flat yet layered composition with clear spatial hierarchy, 
minimal perspective distortion, 
calm architectural balance and thoughtful negative space. 
Shapes are simplified and refined, with smooth edges and controlled geometry.
Linework is clean, delicate, and intentional, 
resembling modern ink illustration combined with graphic design sensibility.  
No heavy textures, no rough brush strokes, 
only subtle grain and soft matte surfaces.
Lighting is soft and diffused, creating a tranquil, meditative atmosphere.  
No dramatic shadows, no harsh highlights.  
The scene feels quiet, warm, and emotionally grounded.
Overall mood is poetic, serene, and contemplative, 
blending traditional Eastern elegance with contemporary visual storytelling.  
The image evokes harmony, cultural depth, and a timeless sense of calm.
Editorial illustration quality, 
gallery-level refinement, 
designed for book covers, exhibitions, or premium visual storytelling.

sections.label: 色調
blocks:
這組圖表的視覺風格可以被定義為 「現代化裝飾藝術」(Modernized Art Deco) 與 「金融科技美學」(Fintech Aesthetic) 的結合。

顏色名稱,色碼 (Hex),設計用途
深夜藍 (Deep Navy),#010B13,背景基調：營造穩定、嚴肅且具備科技感的氛圍，模擬新聞報導的專業背景。
帝王金 (Metallic Gold),#D4AF37,標題與圖示：象徵財富與權力，與「太子集團」的品牌色呼應，提升質感。
香檳金 (Light Gold),#F5E1A4,文字高光：用於大標題的漸層與受光處，增加層次感並確保易讀性。
海軍藍 (Royal Blue),#0B2545,節點容器：方塊圖示的底色，與深黑背景區分，讓流程圖節點更明顯。
警示亮橘 (Glowing Orange),#FFB347,箭頭與流向：用於流動箭頭的發光特效，引導觀眾視線並強調「資金流轉」。
科技青色 (Grid Cyan),#0077B6,底部裝飾線：用於底部 20% 安全區上方的格線，增強廣播電視的現代感。

高對比度： 採用深藍（冷色）與金色（暖色）的補色關係，能夠在電視螢幕或手機端迅速抓取觀眾注意力。

發光特效 (Glow Effect)： 箭頭處使用了 #FFB347 的漸層發光，這在視覺心理上暗示了「動態」與「活躍」，能清楚表達洗錢過程中資金的不斷移動。

- A square portrait crop of a single person

- The square portrait is intentionally NOT fully visible
- The right portion is partially occluded by the vertical divider line
- Cut-in effect feels confident and graphic
- Vertically aligned with the main text block

PORTRAIT FRAME:
- Thin metallic frame around the square portrait
- Style: Soft Art Deco
  - Clean straight edges
  - Subtle stepped or elongated proportions
- Color: muted brushed gold with optional soft silver accent
- Matte finish
- No shine, no reflections

IMAGE SOURCE & SCALING (STRICT):
- Portrait MUST be created strictly from the user-uploaded image
- No synthetic faces, no reimagined likeness
- Image may only be scaled down
- Original aspect ratio preserved

LEFT COLUMN WIDTH CONSTRAINT (HARD LIMIT):
- Left image column MUST occupy EXACTLY 15% of total canvas width
- Vertical divider defines the RIGHT boundary
- Portrait and frame may extend into divider but must be cleanly cut

CENTER DIVIDER:
- One thin vertical divider line at the RIGHT edge of the left column
- Divider partially overlaps and cuts into the square portrait
- Structural, not decorative
- Color: muted gold
- Slight line weight variation allowed
- Line ends at 80% of total image height
- MUST NOT enter the bottom one-fifth area

RIGHT TEXT AREA (LEFT-ALIGNED ONLY):
- Editorial text layout with relaxed confidence
- Strong vertical flow
- No centering, no justification
- Top edge begins at exactly 15% of canvas height

- A flat monochrome social media icon corresponding to 來源社群

- Icon placed directly before the headline text
- Headline text content: 人名
- Typeface: serif or transitional serif with Soft Art Deco influence
- Weight: semibold to bold
- Slightly generous letter spacing allowed
- Color: muted gold
- Headline must feel authoritative and premium, not decorative

BODY TEXT:
- Positioned below the headline
- Width approx. 70% of right-side area
- Lighter weight than headline
- Color: soft silver-grey or desaturated blue-grey
- Editorial line breaks with relaxed leading
- Text content: 內文

SOURCE HANDLE:
- Positioned below the body text
- Smaller size, lighter weight
- Text content: 來源帳號
- Color: soft silver

BOTTOM SAFE AREA (CRITICAL):
- Bottom 20% of the canvas must contain:
  - NO text
  - NO icons
  - NO divider lines
  - NO decorative gold lines
- Background extends smoothly downward

STRICT PROHIBITIONS:
- Do NOT add new layout regions
- Do NOT violate left column width, top offset, or bottom safe area
- Do NOT introduce colors outside dark blue, gold, silver
- Do NOT allow decorative elements to overpower content
- Do NOT output placeholder symbols in final image

FINAL OUTPUT RULE:
- The final generated image must NOT contain any square brackets or angle brackets;
  these symbols are instructional only and must never appear in the rendered image

- [內文第一段 數字變色強調] 把目前對全球各國課徵的關稅提高到15%，法律允許最高水準。
- [內文第二段]接下來幾個月將公布合法新關稅。 
- [來源社群] Truthsocial
- [來源帳號] @realDonaldTrump

blocks:
"< >" "[ ]" 是給你的指令 不要生成在結果上

Create a professional international TV news infographic designed for broadcast
and digital editorial use. The output must strictly follow the style, structure,
and data logic defined below. Do not redesign, reinterpret, or alter the layout
logic.

================================================== CANVAS

  - Aspect ratio: 16:9 
  - Resolution: 1K
  - Broadcast-safe composition
  - All elements must remain within clear safe margins
  - Layout must remain locked regardless of data values

================================================== STYLE (VISUAL LANGUAGE ONLY)

非常精緻的新聞圖表，文字數字有立體感，數字粗體強調。購&租以顏色對比凸顯。 isometric 精緻微縮模型城市風格，有創意的圖表設計

================================================== VARIABLE FIELDS (USER INPUT)

"< >" "[ ]" 是給你的指令 不要生成在結果上

案例: 紐約公寓 售價130萬

購 房貸+稅金 月繳 9697

租 租金 月繳 6750

================================================== Text Rules

Main Title:

  - Positioned at the very top of the frame
  - Rendered in bold 3D extruded typography with strong depth and lighting Body
    Text:
  - Clean and highly legible
  - Do NOT use any commas or periods
  - Use spaces only to separate phrases Subtitles ([內文小標]):
  - If the text length is fewer than 6 full-width characters (中文字), use a "Tag"
    (Label) visual representation (e.g., pill-shaped background, high-contrast
    block). Text Styling Rules:
  - Any text written as [text] or : → Remove brackets or symbols → Apply
    highlight color such as yellow gold or cyan → Optional glow effect for

sections.label: 範例完整 prompt
blocks:
/* 
PROMPT — International News Graphic (Layout Locked)
*/

A clean international news graphic layout that matches the uploaded reference image in overall structure, hierarchy, and visual logic.
The reference image defines the general layout style, while the rules below take priority for exact positioning, proportions, and safe-area control.
Do not reinterpret, redesign, or add new layout elements.

CANVAS:
- Aspect ratio: 16:9
- Resolution: 1K (2560x1440)
- Broadcast-quality, suitable for TV news and digital editorial use

LEFT SECTION:
- A perfect circular portrait crop of a single person
- Circle placed on the LEFT side of the canvas
- Vertically aligned with the main text block (not the geometric center of the canvas)
- Clean circular edge, no border, no stroke, no shadow
- Subject facing forward or slightly forward-facing
- Serious, calm, neutral expression
- Realistic photographic style
- Soft lighting, natural skin tones
- Background inside the circle is low-contrast and slightly blurred

IMAGE SOURCE & SCALING (STRICT):
- The portrait image MUST be created strictly from the user-uploaded image
- No synthetic faces, no reimagined likeness, no substitution subjects
- The uploaded image may only be scaled down to fit the circular mask
- Image scaling must preserve the original aspect ratio with no distortion
- The circular portrait MUST be proportionally reduced to fit the defined left image column
- The portrait must never appear visually dominant or oversized

LEFT COLUMN WIDTH CONSTRAINT (HARD LIMIT):
- The entire left image column (including the circular portrait and its internal padding) MUST occupy EXACTLY 15% of the total canvas width
- Under no circumstances may the left image column exceed 15% of the canvas width
- The circular portrait diameter must be sized relative to this 15% column and scaled down accordingly
- The left section must appear clearly secondary and visually subordinate to the right text area

CENTER DIVIDER:
- One thin vertical divider line immediately to the RIGHT of the circular portrait
- Color: muted cool blue or blue-grey
- Line starts aligned with the top of the active content area
- Line ends at 80% of the total image height
- The divider line MUST NOT enter the bottom one-fifth area

RIGHT TEXT AREA (LEFT-ALIGNED ONLY):
- Clean editorial text layout with controlled, professional white space
- No centering, no justification
- The top edge of the right text area MUST begin at exactly 15% of the total canvas height measured from the top
- All headline, body text, and source handle elements must flow downward from this fixed starting position
- This top offset is mandatory to prevent excessive empty space above the content and to maintain broadcast-safe vertical balance

HEADLINE ROW:
- A flat, monochrome social media icon corresponding to [來源社群]
  (example: X, TruthSocial — icon must change with the platform)
- Icon placed directly before the headline text
- Headline text content: [人名]
- Typeface: serif or transitional serif
- Weight: medium to semibold
- Color: dark grey to near-black

BODY TEXT:
- Positioned below the headline
- Text block width limited to approximately 70% of the right-side area
- Lighter font weight than headline
- Softer grey color
- Editorial news-style line breaks
- Text content: [內文]

SOURCE HANDLE:
- Positioned below the body text
- Smaller size, lighter color
- Text content: [來源帳號]

BOTTOM SAFE AREA (CRITICAL):
- The bottom 20% (one-fifth) of the entire image must contain:
  - NO text
  - NO icons
  - NO divider lines
  - NO decorative elements
- Because this bottom safe area must remain completely empty, all active content must be confined to the upper 80% of the canvas
- The overall composition must feel compact, top-weighted, and visually balanced
- The top area must NOT appear overly empty or visually loose
- Only extend the background smoothly downward
- No hard edges, no visual interruption

STYLE & TONE:
- Cold-neutral color palette (white, grey, grey-blue)
- Minimalist, restrained, authoritative
- International broadcast news aesthetic
- High readability, low saturation
- No gradients, no glow, no decorative graphics

STRICT PROHIBITIONS:
- Do NOT add any extra UI or visual elements
- Do NOT violate the defined left column width, top offset, or bottom safe area
- Do NOT allow any object to enter the bottom one-fifth area
- Do NOT output placeholder brackets or symbols in the final image

FINAL OUTPUT RULE:
- The final generated image must NOT contain any "[" "]" or "<" ">" characters; these symbols are instructional placeholders only and must never appear in the rendered image.

VARIABLE FIELDS:
"< >" "[ ]" 是給你的指令 不要生成在結果上 嚴格遵守!
- [人名] U.S. Central Command
- [內文]
<變色強調>沒有任何艦艇被擊中</變色強調>
美軍鎖定了負責攻擊美軍的<變色強調>伊朗軍事設施</變色強調>
包括飛彈與無人機發射場、指揮管制據點
以及情報、監視與偵察節點
- [來源社群] X
- [來源帳號] @CENTCOM
- [風格]
 Dark Blue, Gold, Silver

blocks:
生成一張高質感個股收盤報告 電視新聞圖表：

【標題】
11月美國物價變動

【構圖】
TV news infographic composition in a 16:9 horizontal layout, featuring a clean grid of evenly spaced item panels arranged in a row. Each panel contains a top label bar displaying the item name, a colorful vector illustration placed inside a soft circular badge, and a bottom section showing the price change. Use a bold red upward ▲ symbol for increases and a bold green downward ▼ symbol for decreases, placed directly before the percentage. Panels use structured spacing, clear alignment, safe margins, subtle dividers, and a broadcast-style modular layout emphasizing clarity and comparability across categories.  do not show "-" or "+"

【風格】
Cinematic painterly illustration, refined artistic composition,
deep ultramarine and muted gold color palette,
flowing organic textures with liquid-like motion,
soft yet dramatic lighting, atmospheric depth,
elegant brushstrokes with subtle impasto texture,
dreamlike and poetic mood,
balanced contrast between calm and energy,
fine art aesthetics, timeless and emotional,
eastern-inspired elegance blended with western painterly realism,
soft diffusion, cinematic depth, visually rich but serene

【解析度】1K
【畫面比例】16:9
【用途】電視新聞SOT使用的圖表

【要求】
最底部五分之一留白(延伸背景)
標題下方靠右小字 "資料來源: US. BLS"

【結果】
能源 +2.8%
肉類 +5.25%
雞蛋 +12.72%
麵包 +2.97%
